name: Mandar

projects.title: Product Configurator
projects.description: An interactive 3D product configurator that allows users to customize chair models in real-time. Features include material selection, color changes, and 360-degree viewing with smooth animations.

projects.title: T-Shirt Configurator
projects.description: A creative web application that combines Fabric.js and Three.js to provide an immersive T-shirt customization experience. Users can add text, upload images, and see real-time 3D previews.

projects.title: Property Search
projects.description: A comprehensive property search platform integrated with MapTiler maps. Features include location-based filtering, interactive maps, property details, and advanced search capabilities.

projects.title: Parallax Wallpapers
projects.description: A curated wallpaper gallery featuring high-quality images with smooth parallax scrolling effects. Includes categorization by resolution, style, and download functionality with responsive design.

projects.title: 3D Model Viewer
projects.description: An innovative 3D portfolio website showcasing projects in an immersive three-dimensional environment. Features interactive 3D models, smooth animations, and modern UI/UX design.

aboutParaLine1: I am an enthusiastic and devoted Frontend Developer with experience in building responsive, user-friendly online apps as a professional and as a hobby. With a strong background in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I specialize in creating dynamic and engaging user interfaces using modern frameworks like as React.js, Vue.js and Next.js.
aboutParaLine2: In my recent projects, I've been working on constructing interactive 3D model viewers with Three.js, as well as complex property search functions that allow users to easily filter properties. My expertise includes increasing site performance and guaranteeing cross-browser compatibility, which improves the overall user experience.
aboutParaLine3: Aside from coding, I enjoy gaming and game creation, and I am always searching for new methods to merge complex graphics and interactivity into web applications. I also love football, and when I have free time, I like to play and watch the game. I'm always willing to pick up new skills and take on challenging projects that test the boundaries of web development. My objective is to grow as a developer and support innovative projects that make a big difference.

resume.tagline: 👋  I'm a Frontend Developer and Gamer.
